traditional: No classical doctrine: Uranus is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: The mind meets disruption and originality. Fast, unconventional, leap-of-insight thinking that resists linear order. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Scattered, jumpy thinking, nervous tension, and impatience with slow or conventional reasoning. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.waxing: Crisis of action: take conscious hold and build a durable form for thinking against disruption, or be thrown off course.
cyclic.waning: Crisis of meaning: break down the thinking/disruption form that has outlived its purpose and reorient toward the next cycle.

business: Friction in this area. Strong for innovation, problem-solving, and tech; weak for routine detail and steady communication.
shadow: Scattered overthinking collides with instability for its own sake; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: Friction builds toward a forced adjustment.
arcSeparating: The crisis passes; what was restructured settles.
base: A message, cancellation, technical problem, or unexpected update can throw a plan off course before the new facts have fully landed.

readerCopy.body: A message, cancellation, technical problem, or unexpected update can throw a plan off course before the new facts have fully landed. When Mercury squares Uranus, information arrives with disruption attached, making schedules shift and the mind race toward the next solution. Speed can imitate clarity under this aspect. Confirming exactly what changed creates a better foundation for rebuilding than reacting to every possibility the surprise seems to imply.
